scope: Bounded D-03/D-06 regression slice: malformed table-cell recovery, malformed Unicode-escaped media references, safe cache invalidation, and Save/Publish separation.

principles.parallel_work_and_safe_reuse: Independent read-only review ran alongside verification. Existing Wrangler, D1 and R2 resources and repository dependencies were reused; no new dependencies were added.
principles.single_canonical_plan: The 13-file master plan was not rewritten. This evidence remains independently versioned under docs/evidence/ as required.
principles.preserve_data: Malformed persisted content remains read-only until the explicit row-repair action. Unknown media references prevent archival; no production data was changed.

runtime: Media-reference candidate SQL now treats malformed JSON containing Unicode escapes as an unknown same-site reference candidate. Usage inventories become incomplete and archive is rejected instead of missing an escaped ID that is absent from the raw JSON bytes.

Structured table Inspector now identifies object/array cells and invalid row shapes before the legacy normalizer can coerce those values to empty strings. The panel remains read-only until an explicit repair; that action replaces only malformed rows and preserves valid rows and headers.

The structured Inspector module and the Editor app/index entry URLs use the new 20261122-d03-table-object-cell-recovery-v1 cache key after the independent review found that the first release still referenced the prior Inspector URL.
tests: Added malformed Unicode-escaped JSON cases across draft page content, published snapshots and editor revisions; each leaves usage incomplete, blocks archival, and preserves media metadata. Invalid published content is not served publicly.
Added object/array table-cell unit coverage, intentional blank-cell compatibility, read-only Inspector behavior and explicit row-only recovery.
Expanded the real Chromium structured-content flow to cover object-valued cells at desktop and mobile widths, Save/reload, unchanged published snapshot, explicit repair, and separate Publish.
changes.generated_evidence: Regenerated docs/evidence/feature-traceability.json after source/test changes. It remains source traceability only and does not assert semantic feature acceptance.
